A LINEAR SLICK WAS OBSERVED TO BE EMANATING FROM THE LOCATION OF AN OIL PIPELINE LOCATED IN THE EUGENE ISLAND 316 AREA AND BELIEVED TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH NOAA NESDIS RESPONSE LINK NRC #1470579 FROM 8/13. UNCERTAINTIES: CLOUD COVER OBSCURED MULTIPLE AREAS OF THE ANOMALY TO INCLUDE THE SUSPECTED SOURCE AT THE NORTHWESTERNMOST END, SOUTHEASTERNMOST AREAS AND CLOUD SHADOW THAT IMPACTED VISIBILITY OF SECTIONS THROUGHOUT THE IMAGE. DUE TO THESE WEATHER CONDITIONS, THE FULL EXTENT OF THE ANOMALY COULD NOT BE DETERMINED. THE OVERALL CONFIDENCE LEVEL OF THE REPORT IS HIGH, BASED ON THE CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE SUSPECTED SOURCE OF RECENT NOAA RESPONSE LINK REPORTING.

Report Description
CALLER STATED THEIR FIRE UNITS WERE DISPATCHED OUT TO THE LOCATION FOR A POSSIBLE FIRE AT THE FACILITY. THERE WAS A LARGE AMOUNT OF WHAT APPEARED TO BE SMOKE COMING FROM THE BUILDING. RESIDENTIAL NEIGHBORS COMPLAINED OF HAVING A HEADACHE AND FEELING SICK FROM THE FUMES. WHEN THEY ARRIVED ON SCENE THEY MADE CONTACT WITH A WORKER FROM THE FACILITY AND THEY WERE TOLD IT WAS JUST VAPORS AND STEAM BEING RELEASED FROM A NEW PROCEDURE THEY WERE DOING. THE MANAGER ARRIVED AND STATED THEY MAKE CHEMICALS FOR A LOCAL DENIM MILL AND THAT DURING THIS PROCESS THEY GENERATED LIQUID WASTE. CALLER STATED THE MANAGER STATED THEY HAD BEEN PAYING A TRUCKING COMPANY TO REMOVE IT BUT THE TRUCKING COMPANY INCREASED THEIR RATES SO THEY WERE NOW TRYING TO ATTEMPT TO VAPORIZE IT BY BOILING IT SO THEY WOULDN"T HAVE TO PAY THE COST TO HAVE IT SHIPPED. CALLER STATED WHEN QUESTIONED ABOUT THE CHEMICALS THEY WOULD NOT IDENTIFY THEM.

THE 3 PERSONNEL NEAR THE DRUM WERE EVALUATED AND CLEARED BY EMS. THERE ARE NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES IN THIS INCIDENT.
